dedupe_keys.name: heat pump and heat pump water heater field database doe pnnl

description: The Heat Pump and Heat Pump Water Heater Field Database is a central repository, built by PNNL with DOE funding, for field validation studies of residential and commercial heat pumps and heat pump water heaters tested by programmes across the United States. Its stated mission is to define a standard data collection format, recruit data and promote a sharing platform between private and government sectors; users can upload complete datasets, build custom downloads by querying project metadata, and view visualisations of key performance metrics. The study search lists each study's type, sector, equipment, whether weather data are included and number of sites, for example a 2026 BPA high-performance heat pump field study with 57 sites, a CADMUS residential study with 43 sites, NREL cold-climate field validations, a Pecan Street sample, Slipstream dual-fuel studies, and several heat pump water heater studies. Coverage: US field studies. Access: free web search and download; login for uploads. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: it is distinct from DOE's Compliance Certification Management System of rated products, and studies differ in metering and duration. Simulation uses: calibrating heat pump performance curves and electrification load models with field data. Related records: HEAPO and the NEEP cold climate heat pump list.
